meta.title: Tides
meta.description: Those crashing waves are far more than simply sea water.

units.rawText: A torrent of Entropics.

spans.text: A torrent of Entropics.

units.rawText:
Densely-packed. Crawling over each other. They're everywhere. Even the seawater has been displaced by the sheer weight of their numbers.
Wave after wave of Entropics squeeze against each other's carapaces, chirping and screeching. Their countless tentacles writhe as they climb outside with abandon.
